race.comment: Former NSW galloper BIANCA MIA (2) has looked handy in both runs since joining the new stable with a close-up second at Townsville two back before getting the job done there last time out. Drawn to get a cosy run in transit from gate two and will be right there when the judge calls a halt. AVENUE MONTAIGNE (3) is an honest galloper who is yet to miss the top-four in ten career outings to date. Doesn't know how to run a bad race and has to be included in calculations. FARAWAY DOWNS (5) has a win and a placing from two attempts over this distance range and will be rock-hard fit for this. Can go back-to-back. BRITISH GEM (6) has put back-to-back victories together at Townsville and is a must for the exotics players. ASPEN COWBOY (1) next in line despite the sticky draw.
